purpose: Validate the household-formation proxy used by the housing-demand indicator independently of population forecast error.

evaluation.populationInput: observed persons implied by SCB households × personsPerHousehold, so the test isolates the household-size assumption
gate: constant mode household-count MAE must not exceed five-year trend at n+1 for both Lulea and FA
constant mode household-count MAE must not exceed five-year trend at n+2 for both Lulea and FA
constant mode household-count MAPE must be <= 2 percent at n+1 for both Lulea and FA
constant mode household-count MAPE must be <= 2 percent at n+2 for both Lulea and FA

constant.formula: future persons / personsPerHousehold at rolling origin

trend.formula: future persons / capped linear extrapolation of personsPerHousehold from first to last observation in most recent five years

governance: The gate is locked before validation results are generated.
Do not tune the five-year window, caps or error thresholds after viewing these outcomes.
This validates an indicative household-formation proxy, not housing-market prices, vacancy or housing shortage.
